label: How incoming connections are accepted
help: Whether someone connecting needs the password, needs the person at the device to click Accept, or either.

label: Which passwords work
help: Which password a connecting person may use: the temporary one RustDesk shows on the device, the fleet password set by this script, or either.

label: Visible on the local network
help: Other RustDesk devices on the same network can find this device. RustDesk's default: on.

label: Direct IP connections
help: Accept connections straight to the device's IP address, bypassing your ID and relay servers. RustDesk's default: off.

label: Remote control (keyboard and mouse)
help: Let a connected person control the device. Off makes sessions view-only. RustDesk's default: on.

label: Clipboard sharing
help: Copy and paste between the two devices during a session. RustDesk's default: on.

label: File transfer
help: Send and receive files during a session. RustDesk's default: on.

label: Sound
help: Play the device's audio on the connecting computer. RustDesk's default: on.

label: Restart from a session
help: A connected person can restart the device and reconnect afterwards. RustDesk's default: on.

label: Session recording
help: A connecting person may record the session on their computer. RustDesk's default: on.

label: TCP tunnelling
help: A connecting person may forward network ports through this device. RustDesk's default: on.

label: Permission preset
help: Choose whether individual permission settings apply, all permissions are on, or the session is view-only.

label: Remote printing
help: Let a connected person print through this Windows device. RustDesk's default: on.

label: Camera
help: Let a connected person use this device's camera. RustDesk's default: on.

label: Remote terminal
help: Let a connected person open a terminal on this device. RustDesk's default: on.

label: Block local input
help: Let a connected person block keyboard and mouse input on this Windows device. RustDesk's default: on.

label: Privacy mode
help: Let a connected person hide this device's screen when supported. RustDesk's default: on.

label: Remote settings changes
help: On lets the connecting side change this device's settings. RustDesk's default: off.

label: Keep awake during incoming sessions
help: Keep this device awake while someone is connected. RustDesk's default: on.

label: Require an open RustDesk window
help: Only allow connection if RustDesk window is open. RustDesk's default: off.

label: Disconnect idle sessions
help: Disconnect inactive sessions after the chosen timeout. RustDesk's default: off.

label: Idle disconnect timeout
help: Minutes before an inactive session disconnects when automatic disconnect is on. RustDesk's default: 10 minutes.
